description: Voirie is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Rimouski. Its tags are HackQC18, HackQC20, Stationnement, Trottoir, Voirie. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
